audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1 falling to 17s. Thick Skin is a nearly-free 3s-cooldown shield fueled by stored damage taken, so an all-in into a fresh shield is wasted burst — force it out with poke first.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the pair from beyond answer range, W the dodge, walk — one-way ledgers per wave. Bad trade: Charging Q inside hook range — the artillery that forgets geography becomes the exhibit.
edits.after: Good trade: poke every walk-up and buy anti-heal — Tongue Lash and Thick Skin both sustain him through chip. Bad trade: burning your combo into a fresh Thick Skin shield; bait it out before you commit.
